# imstruzik.com

> Marcin Struzik is an AI motion designer at GetResponse, with 14+ years in SaaS product
> marketing video and 2,000+ videos made. He covers scripting, video editing, motion design
> and UI animation, and writes The AI Cut: practical notes on what AI does well in a real
> video workflow and what stays human.

Last updated: 2026-10-16. YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@imstruzik

## The AI Cut

All notes: https://imstruzik.com/notes/

- [Free AI Tools for Video Creators: The Resources I Actually Use](https://imstruzik.com/notes/free-ai-video-tools/): free, no-affiliate-link tools for scripting, voiceover, captions, stock footage and mockups, with free-tier limits noted.
- [How to Write an AI Video Script People Watch to the End](https://imstruzik.com/notes/ai-video-script/): start from a three-question brief (the viewer's problem, the frustration that opens the video, the one takeaway), ask AI for five hooks, keep one.
- [AI Video Editing: 7 Tasks to Hand Over Today, and 3 You Never Should](https://imstruzik.com/notes/ai-video-editing/): automate captions, silence removal, resizing, transcription, noise cleanup, first-pass color and B-roll tagging (about 5.5 hours down to under an hour per video); keep pacing, UI-animation timing and story order human.
- [The AI Tools for Video I Stopped Using, and the 4 I Would Keep](https://imstruzik.com/notes/ai-tools-for-video/): the test is whether a tool removes a step or adds a check. Kept: ChatGPT, ElevenLabs, Seedance 2.0, WhisperX.

## Free downloads

https://imstruzik.com/downloads/: Email Blur, a browser extension Marcin built that blurs every email address on a web page before you record your screen (source: https://github.com/struzikmarcin-coder/portfolio/tree/main/tools/email-blur), plus the Product Video Brief, AI Video Script Prompt Pack, Before You Hit Publish checklist and My AI Stack PDFs. All free, unlocked with a newsletter signup.
